thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: GPU_POOL_WATCHER detected high memory pressure in pool gpu-west2a (threshold 92%). PagerDuty incident: PD#98765
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty triggered: https://pd.example/INCIDENT/PD-98765 - urgent_severity
alex: acked on PD, I'm up. looking at pool metrics now.
priya: seeing a spike in eviction count and a few CUDA OOMs in the last 30s. logs attached to the PD.
jamal: can you paste the nvml / kernel lines?
priya: copied logs:
```
[2025-11-03T23:58:12Z] worker-13 kernel: NVIDIA: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid 4231: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2025-11-03T23:58:14Z] infer-2 docker[pid=4231]: RuntimeError: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 1.2 GiB
[2025-11-03T23:58:15Z] nvml: GPU 0: ECC errors none, memory used 31.8 GiB / 32 GiB
```
alex: that looks like tail-of-request kvcache prefetch + a big batch hit. models served: gpt-small-2b pinned on this pool.
emily: customer reports elevated 5xxs for /v1/generate in us-west. correlates with the PD window.
ops-bot: Notified on-call rotation and escalated to secondary after 2m without ack.
jamal: rolling mitigation: 1) temporarily disable kv prefetch on gpu-west2a for model gpt-small-2b 2) trigger burst nodes in west2 region 3) drain worker-13 if kernel continuing to error.
priya: running `curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pools/gpu-west2a/flags -d '{"kv_prefetch":false}'` now.
alex: repinned a subset of traffic off this pool via routing rule `route: gpt-small-2b -> prefer: gpu-west2b` (canary 20%).
emily: ops: update on customer impact? SLA watch?
jamal: prelim assessment: 3 hosted customers with degraded latency and 1 customer with ~1% request failures; will notify CS.
priya: drain started on worker-13: `kubectl cordon worker-13 && kubectl drain worker-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` - graceful evac in progress.
incident-bot: Node worker-13: driver restart requested by alex. Action queued.
alex: decided to restart nvidia driver on worker-13 if drain doesn't free memory in 90s.
pagerduty-bot: PD#98765 acknowledged by alex at 2025-11-03T23:59:05Z. Secondary jamal escalated and joined.
ops-bot: automated scale-up completed: +2 GPU nodes in gpu-west2b (node IDs gw2b-21, gw2b-22) - routing bump to 60% to west2b to absorb load.
priya: eviction rate dropping, no further OOMs on remaining workers. memory headroom up to 70% on pool.
emily: CS notified of temporary customer impact; no committed SLA breach expected but flagged for postmortem.
jamal: handoff: i'm taking 30m until 00:40 UTC to watch stabilization, then handing to night rotation @jamal on-call (primary).
alex: creating follow-up todo: reduce aggressive kv prefetch by default for small models, add a guard to avoid prefetching >8GB per request.
priya: marking incident as mitigated at 2025-11-04T00:05:00Z - no new PD alerts.
incident-bot: Incident PD#98765: status -> mitigated. please fill short incident summary in #incidents.
emily: filing customer comms draft in #support-drafts.
jamal: thanks team — I'll stay on watch and create a postmortem draft with timeline + RCA tomorrow. :thumbsup:
alex: resolved for now. will follow up on runbook updates.
summary: Automated PagerDuty alert for GPU memory pressure in gpu-west2a; kvcache prefetch caused OOMs on gpt-small-2b; mitigated by disabling prefetch, routing traffic to gpu-west2b, draining node and scaling up; PD incident acknowledged and later mitigated; CS notified; handoff and postmortem planned.
